description.value: The Woods Spirit Co. is a family-owned, female-led craft distillery on North Vancouver's North Shore, producing Italian-inspired liqueurs and spirits using a proprietary vacuum distillation process with 100% BC grain and locally sourced botanicals. Their Barrel-aged Amaro earned Best in Class at the 2026 CASC Awards, and the operation includes a cocktail lounge (Bar in The Woods), regular Friday distillery tours, and cocktail workshops. As a BC Green Business Certified enterprise, they prioritize sustainable production and community engagement.
